title_zh: 不要把出口增长写成整体经济复苏

scenario.label_zh: 核对经济报道的结论范围
scenario.goal_zh: 区分单一行业出口数据和整体经济结论并修订报道标题。

context_zh: 新闻写作课上，两名同学检查一份虚构地方经济报道的草稿。
author: author-phase05-b

sentences.speaker: Theo
sentences.text: My headline says the economy has fully recovered. Is that supported by the figures?

sentences.speaker: Yasmin
sentences.text: The report only says local firms export more bicycles than last year.

sentences.speaker: Theo
sentences.text: That is still an economic improvement, though.

sentences.speaker: Yasmin
sentences.text: For those firms, yes. But we have no figures for jobs, household spending, or other industries.

sentences.speaker: Theo
sentences.text: So the headline makes a much bigger claim than the evidence allows.

sentences.speaker: Yasmin
sentences.text: Right. Can you say exactly what grew instead?

sentences.speaker: Theo
sentences.text: I will change it to Local bicycle sales abroad rise, and give the percentage in the first paragraph.

sentences.speaker: Yasmin
sentences.text: That matches the report. Keep the wider recovery question open until you have more evidence.
